about: Sizes in MB for the first-run screen, per system (windows, macos, linux) or 'all'. mb is the download, disk_mb what it takes on disk once installed. 'measured' names the CI run that measured an entry; values without it are estimates (the screen says 'about' for every number). Refresh with daemon/tests/platform_real/first_run_sizes.py from the first-run job's log. The core's disk sizes below are Heliox's environment after the core (and on macOS and Linux the platform readers) in run 43148203234; its downloads are still estimates until that job's next run reports @@size.
